package planted

import "fmt"

type Lang string

type stageInput struct{ Summary string }

type copyTable struct{ drafted string }

const quiet = "This deal went quiet"

var byLang = map[Lang]copyTable{"en": {drafted: "A reply is drafted"}}

var kindPhrases = map[string]string{"merge": "Merge two records"}

func direct() stageInput     { return stageInput{Summary: "Rename the account?"} }
func concat(n string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: "Rename " + n + " to " + n} }
func sprintf(n string) stageInput {
	return stageInput{Summary: fmt.Sprintf("Found on %s", n)}
}
func helper(n string) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s was not sent", n) }
func viaHelper(n string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: helper(n)} }
func reason(code string) string {
	switch code {
	case "x":
		return "a recipient withdrew consent"
	}
	return code
}
func viaSwitch(code string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", code, reason(code))} }
func viaLocal(n string) stageInput {
	was := n
	if was == "" {
		was = "none in force today"
	}
	return stageInput{Summary: fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", n, was)}
}
func viaParam(summary string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: summary} }
func callsViaParam() stageInput         { return viaParam("Is this worth keeping?") }
func viaConst() stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: quiet} }
func viaAssign(n string) stageInput {
	in := stageInput{Summary: n}
	in.Summary = fmt.Sprintf("Archive %s", n)
	return in
}
func verb(approve bool) string {
	if approve {
		return "Approve"
	}
	return "reject"
}
func viaOneWord(id string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", verb(true), id)} }
func viaTable(kind string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: kindPhrases[kind]} }
func formatOnly(a, b string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: fmt.Sprintf("%s → %s", a, b)} }
func forwarded(in stageInput) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: in.Summary} }
func copyField(lang Lang) stageInput {
	said := byLang[lang]
	return stageInput{Summary: said.drafted}
}
func langTable(lang Lang) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: byLang[lang].drafted} }
func identifier(id string) stageInput { return stageInput{Summary: fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", "offer", id)} }
